setup_guide.introduction: I'll investigate a research question, challenge competing hypotheses and prepare an evidence brief with proposed tests for your review. The bundled robotics simulation case uses synthetic measurements; real work needs your research question and approved sources configured first. The packet explains what remains uncertain; experiments are proposed, not executed.

sample.title: Robotics research sample
sample.description: Explore a robotics simulation question using synthetic notes and baseline measurements. The normal research workflow proposes tests without executing them.
sample.expected_output: An evidence brief, ranked hypotheses, counterarguments, evidence gaps and proposed tests for packet review.
